suggestion.recommended_first_action: Roll back the most recent deploy of payments-api; it resolved INC-1042 in 4 minutes.

actions_to_avoid: Restarting pods: no effect in INC-1042 and errors returned in INC-0977
Scaling replicas: made the pool problem worse in INC-1009
